why: Tencent's Hy4 Flash is a model launch with a primary source (Tencent's own announcement, dated November 16, 2026) and independent coverage from three outlets on November 16. Its price, $0.070 per million input tokens and $0.281 per million output tokens, matters to anyone building with low-cost models. The performance and cost-per-task figures come from Tencent's internal blind test and must be attributed to it. The story also has no independent measurement yet.
